from pathlib import Path

def galaxy_mean(path):
    lines = Path(path).read_text().splitlines()
    header = lines[0].lstrip('#').split('\\t')
    values = lines[1].split('\\t')
    return float(values[header.index('mean')])
mut = galaxy_mean('galaxy_outputs/mutant_summary.tsv')
wt = galaxy_mean('galaxy_outputs/wildtype_summary_exact.tsv')
reduction = (wt - mut) / wt * 100
print(f'mutant_mean={mut:g}')
print(f'wildtype_mean={wt:g}')
print(f'percent_reduction={reduction:.10g}')
print(f'rounded_percent={reduction:.0f}%')
